schedule.note: The Worker executes only on its cron ticks. A stored vendor nextAttemptAt is a backoff deadline and is not an attempt time. `nextAttemptTick` applies the Worker's actual due rule (src/refresh.js `isVendorDue`): a failed vendor is attempted at the first tick at or after the strict deadline, while a vendor with no consecutive failures counts as due up to EARLY_DUE_TOLERANCE_MS (15 min) early, so a deadline seconds after a tick is attempted at that tick. `strictTickAtOrAfterDue` is the deadline-only tick recorded for contrast.

sourcing.note: Real delivered totals are ranked for the Ganei Shmuel (גן שמואל) delivery area: Duchan Ganei Shmuel’s online branch sells the exact 4/6/8/10-tub batches at ₪6.30 per 250 g tub plus a ₪28 home-delivery line (anonymous public cart quotes: ₪53.20/₪65.80/₪78.40/₪91.00) with no minimum order and free delivery only above ₪599. For the default Tel Aviv–Yafo locality no reachable permitted vendor can sell a standalone batch: Tiv Taam (₪6.10, ₪29.90 delivery, ₪300 minimum order) and Super Yuda (₪6.70, ₪35 delivery, ₪150 minimum) both publish minimums above every exact batch, and the remaining reachable groceries either do not cover Tel Aviv–Yafo or are blocked by their own bot protection or terms. Totals for Tel Aviv–Yafo stay unknown until a vendor can deliver a batch at or above its minimum; see docs/evidence/tnuva-cottage-cheese-runner-research-20261015.json and docs/evidence/tnuva-cottage-cheese-duchan-cart-20261015.json.
